items: 1.85-inch Full Touch Screen with Customizable Faces - Experience enhanced readability on the expansive 1.85-inch display, designed for quick viewing of health data and notifications even on the move. To reflect your personality, choose from 100+ app-based designs or upload a meaningful photo from your gallery. This makes it a versatile accessory that transitions smoothly from office wear to gym sessions.

Hands-Free Bluetooth Calls and Real-Time Smart Alerts - Stay connected without constantly checking your smartphone. By pairing with your iOS or Android device, you can answer or dial calls directly via the built-in speaker and microphone. It supports vibration alerts for SMS and social media messages, allowing you to stay informed during meetings, driving, or intense workouts when your phone is out of reach.

All-Day Activity Tracking and Wellness Insights - This fitness companion records daily steps, distance, and calorie burn across 100+ sports modes. Beyond physical movement, it monitors heart rate and blood oxygen levels to help you understand your body’s response to exercise. The integrated sleep tracker analyzes your rest patterns, providing insights for improving your nightly recovery and overall energy.

Stress Management Insights - Go beyond basic fitness with advanced monitoring of your physical and mental well-being. This smartwatch tracks daily stress levels and mood trends, providing a more complete picture of your overall health. When feeling overwhelmed, use the built-in guided breathing exercises to find a moment of calm. Combined with continuous heart rate and blood oxygen tracking, it helps you manage your daily energy and recovery more effectively.

Reliable Battery Life and All-Day Waterproof Design - Simplify your routine with a battery that lasts up to 7 days under regular use and 30 days on standby from a single 2.5-hour charge. Its IP68 waterproof rating is designed to keep up with your active lifestyle, making it suitable for daily habits such as hand-washing, walking in the rain, or swimming in shallow water. You can stay focused on your laps or outdoor adventures without the need to remove the device, significantly reducing the hassle of daily maintenance.

items.label: Easy Setup - Setting up this watch is easy with just five steps
items.value: 1. Fully charge your watch; 2. Activate Bluetooth on your phone; 3. Install the app; 4. Open the app and scan the QR code displayed on the watch to pair; 5. Enable the functions you need in the app.

items: Smart Life Assistant with Rich Interactive Tools - Designed for ultimate convenience, the watch features a responsive "wake on wrist raise" screen and adjustable brightness for any lighting. It is packed with practical utilities including remote camera control, weather updates, and a find-my-phone finder. For leisure or focus, access built-in games, set multiple alarms, or use the high-intensity flashlight. Whether managing your schedule or enjoying a quick break, these versatile tools are accessible directly from your wrist.

All-Day Comfort with Two Interchangeable Bands - Designed for extended wear, the watch features a soft, skin-friendly strap that ensures breathability and comfort during sleep or intense workouts. The package includes an extra replacement band, allowing you to easily switch styles or refresh the look of your watch. With its quick-release pin design, swapping bands is effortless, making it a versatile and value-packed choice for both men and women who value both fashion and functionality.
